specification.objective: Supersede team-normal-surfaces-v2 as current specification: preserve implemented soft normal selection and strong high contrast while correcting obsolete tests and covering actual global contrast toggle and keyboard activation.

requirements.statement: Correct obsolete selected-background assertions to actual theme tokens while preserving contrast thresholds and covering light and dark.
Verify employee selection differences, high contrast, real global toggle and Enter keyboard activation without changing runtime behavior.
Store byte-identical locked v3 contract; v3 supersedes v2.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Selected employee text retains at least 4.5 contrast against actual selected surface in both themes; selected and unselected surfaces differ, and high-contrast selection remains strong.
Real global contrast toggle and Enter activation are exercised in employee UI.
Archived v3 contract equals locked contract bytes.

invariants.statement: All existing content contrast limits, runtime behavior and accessibility remain unchanged.

forbidden_states.statement: Contrast thresholds are removed or weakened, or high contrast is weakened.

inputs.statement: Employee list and profile widgets and global theme.

outputs.statement: Normalized scoped surfaces and regression coverage.

failure_semantics.statement: Widget regression fails if employee surfaces use wrong theme colors.
